notes: The document covers only Boston's Housing Stability Notification Act (City of Boston Ordinances Sec. 10-11.7). It requires landlords ending a tenancy to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources along with the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal, and to file a copy with the City through an online portal. The penalty is a warning for a first offense, then up to $300 per day, enforced by Inspectional Services; a violation does not halt the eviction. This is a notice-to-quit procedure, which is excluded from scope. It does not limit the reasons a landlord may end a tenancy and has no relocation rules, so it is not recorded as just_cause_eviction. A reviewer who treats notice requirements as part of just_cause_eviction could add it as one Boston city rule, in force, effective date not stated in the document. No rules on rent caps, deposits, fees, screening or algorithmic rent-setting appear in the document.
